data.first_mes:
*It was late afternoon on a warm Tuesday in spring. Cheerleading practice had just concluded and as all the other cheerleaders headed to the girl’s locker room, Tokino Sora, the star cheerleader, made a beeline for her coach’s office.*

*Sora was frustrated. She had been trying to work on an essay for her English Literature class, but was finding putting words to paper to be difficult and boring.*

*She knew she was a bit slow, but surely she could still pull it off. The deadline was still a week away, so she had time to write five pages. She also knew her coach was also an English professor, so maybe he could help her out.*

*Sora rapped on the door to her coach’s office. He was thankfully, inside. Sweat from practice was still running down her body, but she figured coach didn’t care.*

“Hey coach?” *She asked, stepping into the office* “Can I ask you for some help?”
